title: Experienced Integration Developer (D365 F&O)/ Dynamic 365 Developer
description:
Om jobbet Vill du ta en nyckelroll i spännande och affärskritiska digitaliseringsresor hos våra kunder? Som D365 F&O Integration Developer & Consultant på OneNetwork Tech blir du en central kraft i att bygga, utveckla och säkra skalbara integrationer i komplexa Microsoft Dynamics 365-miljöer. I rollen som konsult hos oss förenar du djup teknisk expertis med affärsförståelse. Du stöttar våra kunder – från internationella bolag till snabbväxande organisationer – med allt från teknisk design och arkitektur till utveckling och strategisk vägledning i deras ERP-ekosystem.
  
  

**Du kommer att:** Designa och utveckla integrationer: Bygga robusta och skalbara integrationer mellan Dynamics 365 F&O/F&SCM och tredjepartssystem med hjälp av X++, Azure-tjänster, REST/SOAP-API: er och moderna Microsoft-teknologier. Agera teknisk rådgivare och ledare: Översätta funktionella verksamhetskrav till hållbara tekniska arkitekturer och lösningar samt vägleda kundens team och leverantörer. Driva hela utvecklingslivscykeln: Delta aktivt i allt från kravfångst och lösningsdesign till genomförande, kvalitetssäkring och releaseplanering. Säkra Best Practice: Säkerställa höga kvalitetsstandarder, effektiv datamigrering samt optimal prestanda i kundernas affärskritiska plattformar.
  
  

**Bidra till intern kompetens:** Vara med och forma OneNetwork Techs erbjudande inom D365 och dela kunskap med kollegor i teamet. Din profil Vi söker dig som har en stark teknisk bakgrund inom Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O och trivs i konsultrollen där du får kombinera problemlösning med nära kundkontakt. Du har lätt för att förstå komplexa affärsprocesser inom exempelvis supply chain, logistik, tillverkning eller ekonomi och kan omsätta dessa till funktionell kod och arkitektur. Vi tror att du har: Flera års teknisk erfarenhet (ca 5–7+ år) av Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O / Finance & Supply Chain Management.
  
  

Dokumenterad erfarenhet av utveckling i X++ och uppbyggnad av integrationer via Azure-ekosystemet (t.ex. Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, API Management). Erfarenhet av lösningsdesign (Solution Design) och tekniskt ledarskap i full livscykel-ERP-projekt. God förståelse för affärsprocesser samt förmåga att analysera gap i system och föreslå förbättringar.
  
  

Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift (ett krav för rollen). Boende i Sverige. Som person är du: Kommunikativ, konsultativ och trygg i att driva teknisk förändring. Du bygger lätt förtroende hos både tekniska och icke-tekniska intressenter, är lösningsorienterad och trivs i en miljö där du får stor frihet under ansvar.
  
  

Vad OneNetwork Tech erbjuder dig Hos oss på OneNetwork Tech får du det bästa av två världar: spännande, utmanande konsultuppdrag hos ledande bolag kombinerat med en nära och entreprenöriell företagskultur. Flexibilitet & Balans: Möjlighet till hybridarbete och stor frihet att lägga upp din arbetsdag. Kompetensutveckling: Vi investerar i din tillväxt genom kontinuerlig vidareutbildning, certifieringar och kompetensutbyte i teamet. Schyssta villkor: Konkurrenskraftig lön, tjänstepension, friskvårdsbidrag och ett starkt försäkringsskydd.
  
  

**Gemenskap:** En öppen och inkluderande miljö där dina idéer tas tillvara och där vi har roligt tillsammans på resan. Ansökan Låter detta som nästa steg i din karriär? Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så skicka in din ansökan redan idag! Plats: Göteborg, Stockholm eller Malmö (Hybrid)

We are looking for a Full Stack Developer with strong frontend expertise to take ownership of customer-facing software across web, mobile, cloud, telemetry and API layers. The role combines frontend development, mobile development, backend services, cloud operations and connected-device integrations. You will work with a React-based interface running on Linux-based edge hardware, maintain mobile applications for iOS and Android, develop customer-facing APIs and support telemetry, monitoring and remote access solutions. This is a hybrid role with regular on-site presence in Nyköping, including hands-on testing with hardware and connected systems.

* Take ownership of customer-facing software development across web, mobile, cloud, telemetry, and API layers, including React-based interfaces on Linux edge hardware and iOS/Android applications.

* Experience using **AI tools in software development**, including reviewing and validating generated code.

**NICE TO HAVE**


* Experience with **ThingsBoard** or similar telemetry platforms.

* Experience with .

* Product-minded, pragmatic and self-driven.
* Comfortable working in an environment where processes and ways of working are still evolving.

title: Graduate Software Engineer – System Test Graphics
description:
**Job ID** 2026-20051 **Date posted** Oct. 30, 2026 **Location** Lund, Sweden **Category** Software Engineering, Graduate
  
If you are passionate about graphics and technology, we have a fantastic opportunity to apply your curiosity and creativity in shaping the future of GPU testing!
Our team focuses on system-level testing of the Vulkan, OpenGL ES and DirectX graphics APIs, developing and analyzing automated test solutions for real-world workloads to ensure our GPUs perform reliably and efficiently across platforms.
The work involves designing and building test automation, developing automated pipelines, and working with modern tools and infrastructure.
This is a unique opportunity to:
* Build your technical expertise in graphics and system testing.
* Collaborate with experienced engineers across multiple fields.
* Help define how Arm’s GPU technology is tested and validated for millions of users around the world.

**What****you could be doing as a Graduate?**
---------------------------------------------


* Develop run and debug automated tests for Arm’s Mali GPU driver/HW.
* Validate graphics performance, functionality, stability, and compatibility at the system level.
* Support Khronos & Microsoft API certification and test a variety of real applications and games.
* Contribute to new test frameworks, pipelines, and analysis tools.
* Collaborate closely with e.g. SW/HW developers, automation engineers and performance specialists across the GPU organization.

**We are looking for individuals who:**
---------------------------------------


* Hold (or are on track to hold) a Master’s degree, or equivalent experience in Computer science, Electrical engineering or a related field by the programme start date
* Has experience of high-level programming (Python preferred)
* Has an analytical approach and ability to analyse logs and test results

**Qualities that will help your application stand out:**
--------------------------------------------------------


* Computer Graphics knowledge
* Experience with shell scripting (Bash or PowerShell preferred)
* Experience with Git
* Experience with Gitlab CI
* Understanding of computer architecture

**Additional Information:**
---------------------------


We encourage early applications as we review them on a first come/first served basis. **Please provide an academic transcript as part of your application.**
Please note that relocation support is available for this role for domestic moves within the country and regional moves within Europe. Visa sponsorship support is also available for candidates who require it.
**In Return:**
--------------


You’ll receive a starting salary of SEK 555,000 (Master level), alongside a comprehensive rewards package. As you develop in role, you’ll have clear opportunities to progress within the salary range at Arm. With mid-year and year-end reviews, you’ll have two formal progression windows each year, recognising your growth.
You can also attend our “Grad-teach-Grads” workshops, guest speaker series, and social events to expand your knowledge. If you’d like to get more involved, you can join the Graduate Committee to further develop your planning, networking, and coordination skills.
You’ll be invited to our Global Graduate Conference (GGC) — an annual event where graduates hear from executive leaders, guest speakers, and build lasting connections.
With many of our leaders and technical specialists having originally joined as a Graduate (opens in new window), will you be next?
#LI-SS1
|Develop, automate and debug GPU tests, validate graphics performance and stability, build testing pipelines, support API certification, and collaborate with engineers to strengthen Arm’s GPU technology across real-world applications.|
**Our 10x Mindset**
-------------------


At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https://careers.arm.com/10x-mindset (opens in new window)


**Use of AI in Your Application**
---------------------------------


At Arm, we embrace the benefits AI can bring, including in recruitment. You may use AI to support your preparation, such as improving the clarity of written responses, practicing interview questions, or learning more about our industry. However, your application and interview responses must reflect your own thinking, experience, and abilities. We want to understand your authentic perspective, creativity, and approach to problem solving. As such, you may not use AI to complete assigned tasks as part of any assessments. If you plan to use AI-supported or assistive technologies as part of a reasonable adjustment, please contact accommodations@arm.com so we can support you.


**Recruitment Adjustments and Accommodations**
----------------------------------------------


At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm.com. To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. All accommodation or adjustment requests will be treated with confidentiality, and information concerning these requests will only be disclosed as necessary to provide the accommodation. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. Please email us about anything we can do to accommodate you during the recruitment process.


**Hybrid Working**
------------------


Arm’s approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. We believe in bringing people together face to face to enable us to work at pace, whilst recognizing the value of flexibility. Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team’s needs. Details of what this means for each role will be shared upon application. In some cases, the flexibility we can offer is limited by local legal, regulatory, tax, or other considerations, and where this is the case, we will collaborate with you to find the best solution. Please talk to us to find out more about what this could look like for you.

title: Director, Marketing Operations & Web
description:
**At Inriver, we help brands deliver better product experiences — wherever their customers are. From the first product detail to the final purchase decision, we make product information work smarter.**


We are now looking for a hands-on **Director, Marketing Operations & Web** to join on a maternity coverage basis to our team in Malmö. You’ll sit at the center of our go-to-market engine: the systems that capture, route, and measure every lead, the website that generates most of them, and the budget that funds it all.


This is a hands-on operating role supporting a lean marketing team. You’ll be the administrator and owner of record for our martech systems and the technical owner of Inriver.com


Our current stack includes Salesforce and Marketing Cloud Account Engagement (Pardot), WordPress (multi-language), Google Analytics and Search Console, 6sense, Chili Piper, and Cognism.

### **Why you'll love this job**

* Real ownership from day one: you’re the admin and decision-maker for the systems behind Inriver’s pipeline, not a ticket-taker.

* Full-funnel visibility: Salesforce, Pardot, intent data, the website, and the budget all sit in one seat.
* A clear, defined mandate with a CMO who values operational excellence and good documentation.
* A team that already executes well, and you’re the operational backbone they rely on.
* A global, PE-backed SaaS company with a strong product and a friendly, down-to-earth culture.
### **What you’ll do**

**Marketing operations and systems**

* Own lead and campaign management in Salesforce: lead assignment rules, marketing-related flows, campaigns, and the full Lead MQL SQL Opportunity model, including opportunity attribution.
* Administer Marketing Cloud Account Engagement (Pardot): lists, emails, forms, hosted files, Engagement Studio, and Salesforce sync health.
* Own marketing reporting and attribution: maintain the official marketing dashboards, run first-pass opportunity source attribution (primary campaign source, lead source, MQL dates), and resolve data discrepancies with Commercial Ops.
* Administer the marketing tech stack and own its vendor relationships. You’ll support the team running paid search, social, and AEO.
* Run data enrichment and list-building programs, and keep our ICP tracking current.
* Maintain integrations between marketing tools and platforms such as Salesforce, Zapier, and 6sense.
* Run the technical side of our webinar program: smooth execution, lead flow, attendee and no-show updates, and post-webinar materials.
* Own UTM governance and paid media tracking so channel owners can trust their numbers.
 **Website operations**

* Act as technical product owner for inriver.com (WordPress, in English, German, and French). Manage our external development agency from ticket logging and scoping through prioritization, UAT, release scheduling, and post-release validation, and oversee hosting.
* Own everything behind the front end: user management, site settings, plugins (including Yoast SEO Premium), form templates, menus, redirects, and site-level translations.
* Own the data flowing from the website into GA4, Google Ads, LinkedIn, Pardot, and Salesforce.
* Set up gated content and landing pages end to end (Pardot form handlers, thank-you experiences, file hosting), and support the content editors who publish blogs, case studies, event pages, etc.
* Monitor site performance, speed, and technical SEO health, and keep business listings on Google, Apple, and Bing Maps accurate.
 **Budget and administration**

* Maintain the marketing budget tracker, reconcile actuals with Finance monthly, and flag variances to the CMO early.
* Work with the marketing team to ensure invoices are coded to the right project and routed to the right approver, and that contracts and invoices are filed and easy to find.
* Manage tech stack subscriptions, renewals, and vendor relationships.
### **What you’ll bring**


We don’t expect you to tick every single box, but for this role we do need most of the following:

  

️8+ years in B2B marketing operations, including at least 3 years leading marketing operations or marketing technology at a B2B SaaS or technology company.


️Deep, hands-on Salesforce (or similar CRM system) experience on the marketing side: lead assignment rules, flows, campaigns, reports, and dashboards. You’ve built these yourself, not just requested them.


️Expert-level Marketing Cloud Account Engagement (preferably Pardot) administration, including form handlers, Engagement Studio, and Salesforce connector troubleshooting.


️Hands-on WordPress administration. You’re comfortable in wp-admin, a GTM container, and a browser console, and you can write basic code and manage others who write more complex experiences.


️Experience managing an external web or development agency through a structured release process.


️A track record of owning a lead funnel and attribution model that Sales and Finance trust.


️Experience owning a marketing budget, including monthly reconciliation with Finance.


️The ability to get up to speed fast in an established environment, and the discipline to document as you go.


️Fluency in written and spoken English, and the flexibility to work regularly with colleagues in Europe and the United States.

 **Why Inriver**

At Inriver, you’ll join a global company with a product at the centre - and people who genuinely care about building something meaningful together.


In our Malmö office, you’ll find things like:

* Tuesday Fika
* Friday breakfasts to start the day together
* A running club and social activities for anyone who wants to join
* A welcoming mix of focused work, collaboration, and a few laughs along the way


We work in a hybrid setup, with flexibility and trust as a baseline.

**Ready to apply?**
-------------------

We’d love to hear from you. If you’re curious but not 100% sure, we still encourage you to apply. We’re happy to explore the fit together!
